import argparse
import time

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Pomodoro Timer")
    parser.add_argument('--work', type=int, required=True, help='Duration of work in seconds')
    parser.add_argument('--break', type=int, required=True, help='Duration of break in seconds')
    parser.add_argument('--rounds', type=int, required=True, help='Number of rounds')
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    if args.work < 0 or args.break < 0 or args.rounds < 1:
        print("Error: Work duration must be non-negative, break duration must be non-negative, and rounds must be at least 1.")
        return
    
    for round_number in range(1, args.rounds + 1):
        print(f"Round {round_number}: Work for {args.work} seconds")
        time.sleep(args.work)
        
        if round_number < args.rounds:
            print(f"Round {round_number}: Break for {args.break} seconds")
            time.sleep(args.break)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
